novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that models encode a "latent compute-budget estimate in the residual stream" before generating any reasoning token and that this estimate "causally controls how long the model thinks," making the novelty route a new prompt-stage mechanistic relationship rather than merely a new application setting. Searches using "pre-reasoning compute budget residual stream CoT length prediction," "prompt-stage activation steering reasoning length overthinking," and "hidden-state prediction reasoning token length" identify the closest work as Mitigating Overthinking in Large Reasoning Models via Manifold Steering (2025), which already represents overthinking with activation-space directions and steers them to reduce tokens, while PALACE (2025) predicts reasoning length externally rather than locating a causal internal budget representation. Although linear probing and single-vector steering are standard and overlap substantially with Manifold Steering, moving from that work to a pre-first-token representation whose miscalibration against difficulty determines later reasoning length requires a new core relationship, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
